title: Sources: OpenAI executives have warned staff over potential espionage like honey pots and insider threats and told them to adopt operational security measures (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: OpenAI executives have warned staff over potential espionage like honey pots and insider threats and told them to adopt operational security measures — From ‘honey pots’ to insider threats, Silicon Valley was on espionage alert even before the FBI's arrest of an OpenAI employee
